note: Effective access is derived from tagging, coverage and tag-test match; it is counted as an axis but not as an additional fitted primitive.

config_parameters.name: n_cells
config_parameters.justification: network resolution, not mouse CA3 cell count

config_parameters.name: overlap_fraction
config_parameters.justification: replace with measured A/B cellular overlap

config_parameters.name: max_active_fraction
config_parameters.justification: fast inhibition reduction, tied to engram fraction

config_parameters.name: cue_target_fraction
config_parameters.justification: strong partial-cue fraction used in independent qualification

config_parameters.name: weak_cue_target_fraction
config_parameters.justification: subthreshold cue control used in independent qualification

config_parameters.name: tag_test_match_fraction
config_parameters.justification: replace with bare-A versus final-A cellular match

external_parameters.name: learned_support_lambda
external_parameters.justification: replace probability-to-retrieval mapping with tone pilot

external_parameters.name: tone_cue_scale
external_parameters.justification: calibrate cue efficacy, separate from lambda

external_parameters.name: manipulation_strength
external_parameters.justification: calibrate ArchT/ChR2 efficacy; phase map sweeps it

external_parameters.name: behavior_inverse_temperature_beta
external_parameters.justification: calibrate signed neural evidence to digging discrimination

external_parameters.name: pre_cue_light_steps
external_parameters.justification: represents light-before-cue ordering, not elapsed biological seconds

external_parameters.name: effective_access_fraction
external_parameters.justification: exact accessible-tag intersection with final A; phase-map axis
